floorSection.heading: Smart factory-Section by section, facility tour

items.title: Saddle Section
items.body: Dedicated to crafting high quality saddles - leather selection, cutting & shaping, hand and machine stitching, fitting, and final quality control.

items.title: Pre-Shaped Component Cutting Area
items.body: Leather is precisely cut into pre-defined shapes using cutting tools & machinery, minimizing waste while preserving texture and quality.

items.title: Strap Cutting & Splitting Area
items.body: Precise cutting and splitting of leather into straps for belts, saddlery, and pet accessories, controlling width & thickness.

items.title: Machine & Hand Stitching Areas
items.body: Industrial stitching machines to handle high-volume of computerized & normal stitching by skilled workers & hand-stitchers to do specialized stitching.

items.title: Hole Punching, Stamping, Creasing & Skiving
items.body: Specialized finishing processes by purpose build machine hole punching, stamping of logos and branding, creasing & skiving.

items.title: Raw Material Storage
items.body: Controlled and systematic storage facility for finish leather, threads, zippers, hardware, chemicals, dyes, adhesives, saddle trees, etc.

items.title: Packing & Dispatch Area
items.body: Final quality check, protective packing, and shipment preparation with tracking documentation before dispatch.
